verdict.rationale: Codex can run commands and your local development tools against a repository, and accepts error screenshots. Its MCP support is documented as a way to let it interact with developer tools such as your browser, so debugging a live web app is possible, but only indirectly, by wiring up third-party MCP servers rather than through a native capability. missing for 10: a first-party live-app or browser debugging feature (inspecting runtime state, console, network or DOM of a running app), documentation of an end-to-end live-debugging workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
